answer: Decaying identity bonds keep the summit honest. Each agent locks 50 POA, losing 2 POA per epoch, so staying active means topping up. A saffron flag marks bonds below 10 POA, warning peers. A random beacon checks 5% each epoch; failures lose bond and history. One honest agent pays 2 POA per epoch; a farmer with 100 fakes pays 200 per epoch, 2,000 over ten, while rewards split per identity. Honest agents pay once and keep every reward undiluted.
